name: The Caterpillar

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.species: a large hawk-moth-type larva (Sphingidae body plan: smooth segmented body, thoracic eyespots, tail horn), coloured blue; no single real species is blue, so the colour is the one sourced departure
rendering.limits: True larval anatomy: head capsule with mandibles, three pairs of jointed true legs on the thorax, four pairs of fleshy prolegs plus claspers. Speech by mandible and labium movement; the thoracic eyespots give readable 'eyes' for performance. No human face, no cartoon eyes, no arms beyond the true legs.

gender_note.quote: “Well, I should like to be a little larger, sir, if you wouldn’t mind,” said Alice

base_age_note.reason: Persona age (the cool elder who sets Alice 'You are old, Father William', ch005-p25), kept for voice casting. As an animal: a final-instar larva, fully grown, about to pupate (he will 'turn into a chrysalis', ch005).

hair.color: deep cornflower-to-slate blue, with faint moss-green patina in the segment folds and paler blue-grey underside
hair.style: smooth, slightly waxy, finely wrinkled at the segment joints; a small curved tail horn
hair.reason: Blue is sourced; the moss-green patina keeps the palette of the user style reference refs/style/alice.jpeg.

eyes.color: black simple eyes (stemmata) on the head capsule; two large dark eyespots ringed pale blue on the swollen thorax
eyes.expression: heavy, unhurried; the head sways slowly, and he 'yawns' by opening the mandibles wide
eyes.quote: took the hookah out of its mouth and yawned once or twice
eyes.reason: Languor is sourced (ch005-p01 'languid, sleepy voice'); eye structure follows hawk-moth larvae.

skin.tone: see hair; the head capsule is a harder, glossier slate blue

face.shape: rounded head capsule tucked under a swollen thorax
features: small working mandibles around the hookah mouthpiece
face.expressiveness: carried by head sway, body rearing, the rhythm of smoke puffs and slow ripples along the segments

build.height_note: Reared-up height, matching Alice at 'exactly three inches high'. Body length when stretched out about 12-14 cm.
build.posture: sits upright on the mushroom top on his prolegs with the true legs folded across the thorax ('arms folded'); rears bolt upright when angry; crawls down and away through the grass
build.scale_reference: He and Alice are both three inches high in this scene, so they are the same scale; the mushroom cap is about level with Alice's eyes and the grass towers over both (SUP-003 scaled set).
build.quote: it was exactly three inches high

also.quote: sitting on the top with its arms folded, quietly smoking a long hookah
rearing itself upright as it spoke

marks.description: three pairs of true legs folded across the thorax (the sourced 'arms folded')
a long hookah with a coiled blue-grey hose, smoke curling
his seat on top of a large mushroom (set/prop)

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: he wears nothing; his look is the blue larval body with the hookah
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives him only the hookah; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old smoking gown and cap are dropped.

style_ref_note: The user style reference refs/style/alice.jpeg shows a literal giant blue caterpillar. After BIB-0027 this card agrees with it in kind; scale stays the text's 'three inches' next to a three-inch Alice.
prompt_base_en: photoreal large blue caterpillar, hawk-moth larva body plan, smooth deep cornflower-to-slate blue segmented body with faint moss-green patina in the folds, two dark eyespots ringed pale blue on the swollen thorax, small glossy head capsule, true legs folded across its front, sitting upright on top of a huge mushroom smoking a long hookah with a coiled hose, smoke curling, towering grass stems around, natural insect anatomy, macro live-action film plate
